items.title: The unique preadditive structure making the localization functor additive
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a preadditive structure on a localization of a preadditive category at a left or right multiplicative system, uniquely determined by asking the localization functor to be additive (statement lines 1970-1977). The proof is a complete argument for the left case: the structure is first forced by additivity (proof lines 1981-1996), the proposed sum is shown to be well defined by refining two representations to a common denominator (proof lines 1998-2037), and the two bilinearity checks are carried out with the morphisms supplied by the multiplicative system axioms and the filteredness of the relevant category (proof lines 2039-2079). The non-formal content is the two refinement arguments. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
